_meta.method: Reset each of the 16 cases to its pre-129b926 state (label=AMBIGUOUS with the reason recorded in the parent of commit 129b926). Re-adjudicate each under ADJUDICATION_RULES.md §3. Production cases (10) verified by fetching the actual source from GitHub at the pinned SHA and tracing each hop with file:line. Demo cases (6) adjudicated under both scope variants: variant (a) examples IN scope (adjudicate on reachability), variant (b) examples OUT of scope (remove from population).
_meta.direction_summary: NOT one-directional. 2 cases moved AMBIGUOUS -> AGENT_REACHABLE (idx 4 and idx 130); 14 moved AMBIGUOUS -> NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE. This reverses the asymmetric Task-5 result in which all 16 moved AMBIGUOUS -> NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE.
_meta.reversal_reason: Task 5 missed two real agent boundaries: agno FileSystemTools.move_file registered via the dynamic getattr(self, name) pattern (idx 4, DYNAMIC_DISPATCH), and openai-agents SandboxApplyPatchTool._on_invoke_tool (idx 130, CROSS_MODULE_CALL via WorkspaceEditor._write_text -> session.mkdir). Both are now AGENT_REACHABLE.
_meta.confirmed_reason: The other 14 stay NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE. For the 10 production cases the Task-5 conclusion holds but the Task-5 EVIDENCE was sometimes wrong; this re-adjudication records the corrected chain. For the 6 demo cases the conclusion holds under scope variant (a); under variant (b) they are removed from the population entirely.
_meta.load_and_search_trace: Traced LoadAndSearchToolSpec.load at run-llama/llama_index @ 199e9b5b130bbde72639358a08935b913e7132c0, file llama-index-core/llama_index/core/tools/tool_spec/load_and_search/base.py. load() is registered as an agent tool (FunctionTool.from_defaults(fn=self.load, ...) at base.py:86-92, exposed via to_tool_list() at base.py:121). On first call, if self._index is None, load() calls self._index_cls.from_documents(docs, **self._index_kwargs) at base.py:153. self._index_cls defaults to VectorStoreIndex (set in from_defaults() at base.py:96). VectorStoreIndex.from_documents does NOT call OraLlamaVS.from_documents. OraLlamaVS.from_documents (oracledb/base.py:770) and OraLlamaVS.drop() (oracledb/base.py:671) are the only callers of drop_table_purge (oracledb/base.py:382). Neither OraLlamaVS.from_documents nor OraLlamaVS.drop is reached from an agent boundary. CONCLUSION: LoadAndSearchToolSpec.load does NOT chain to drop_table_purge. The Task-5 evidence 'vector_store_admin_via_indexing_api' reached the right answer (NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE) for the wrong reason. The corrected reason is 'vector_store_admin_no_agent_chain': drop_table_purge is only reachable from OraLlamaVS.drop()/from_documents() admin methods, neither of which is called by an agent boundary in repository-local code.

On first call (when `self._index is None`), load() calls `self._index_cls.from_documents(docs, **self._index_kwargs)` at base.py:153. `self._index_cls` defaults to `VectorStoreIndex` (set in from_defaults at base.py:96, `index_cls = index_cls or VectorStoreIndex`). CONCLUSION: LoadAndSearchToolSpec.load does NOT chain to drop_table_purge. The only @kernel_function in this code path is search_wrapper (data/vector.py:2092) which is created by VectorSearch._create_kernel_function. search_wrapper calls `self.search(values=query, ...)` (data/vector.py:2117) -> VectorSearch.search (data/vector.py:1801) -> `await self._inner_search(...)` (data/vector.py:1843) -> SqlServerCollection._inner_search (sql_server.py:539) -> _fetch_records (sql_server.py:566) -> `cur.execute(*query.to_execute())` (sql_server.py:571) — a SELECT query, not a destructive operation.
